trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order, save the long grinds (cards, WAiNK, shooting range) for the middle stages, and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 so the one missable trophy can never lock you out of this one.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Check the tracker: when the counter reads 54/55, this one pops automatically.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission. Follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing trip — the mission is scripted and cannot be failed in a way that matters. It pops at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Start a new game and play through the opening until the Gone Fishing mission begins.
Follow the prompts to the end of the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave Chapter 1, make a manual save — the balcony meditation trophy later in the game can only be done from a Chapter 1 save, and this is your safety net.
steps: Play every Chapter 1 story mission to completion.
Make a manual save the moment Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2's story missions. Side activities are optional here — push the story forward and the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.
steps: Follow the story markers through Chapter 2.
Finish the final mission of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 opens up Vice City proper. Play the story missions in order; the chapter trophy pops when the last one is done. Use the downtime between missions to try one activity type for the Master of None trophy.
steps: Complete each Chapter 3 story mission.
Finish the chapter's closing mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the longest stretch of the story so far. Keep pushing the missions; there is no missable content in this chapter, so play at your own pace.
steps: Complete each Chapter 4 story mission.
Finish the chapter's closing mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The last mission of the game. Before you start it, clear the open-world grinds you can (races, stunts, shops) so the finale is a victory lap, not a chore. The gold pops at the credits.
steps: Reach the final story mission.
Complete it to roll the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early story mission — follow the marker, do what the mission asks, and the trophy pops at completion. A good early mission to learn the driving and the partner mechanics.
steps: Start the Breakfast Run mission from the story marker.
Complete it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a set-piece mission — stick with your crew, follow the plan the game lays out, and mind the escape route. It pops at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Start The Cartel Heist from the story marker.
Complete the heist and escape.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission that leans on stealth and timing rather than firepower. Take the quiet route the game hints at and the mission ends cleanly.
steps: Start the Child's Play mission.
Complete it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a loud mission — expect a firefight and a chase. Stock up on armour and ammo first, then follow the mission markers through to the end.
steps: Stock armour and ammo before starting.
Start Headliners and complete it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown sends you into the airport grounds. The mission is vehicle-heavy, so pick a fast car before you start and keep moving once the alarms go up.
steps: Bring a fast vehicle to the mission start.
Complete VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is the big military-style mission of the late story. Heavy weapons help; the game supplies what you need on site, so focus on the objectives and keep your crew alive.
steps: Start Operation Savage Glory.
Complete every objective to the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion counts the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles — basically everything this guide tracks. Do not chase it first: play the story, then mop up the checklist. The in-game stats page shows exactly what is left.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand.
Clear the remaining activities and collectibles shown in the stats page.
Confirm 100% in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts — the game counts them as you drive. The fastest route is a stunt loop: a long highway stretch with ramps and traffic, repeated with a fast bike. 250 sounds like a lot; a focused session clears it in about two hours.
steps: Take a fast bike to a long highway with ramps.
Chain jumps, near-misses and airtime until the counter hits 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once: a race, a fishing challenge, an arcade game, a drone race, a shooting-range challenge and the rest. You do not need to win any of them — just try each one and the trophy pops.
steps: Open the activities list in the pause menu.
Try each activity type once, even if you lose.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Every Shooting Range challenge needs a gold medal — a 42-target gold-medal grind in total, and the hardest pure-skill trophy in the game. Learn one weapon at a time, use the range's practice mode first, and take breaks: rushing it only builds bad habits.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list.
Practice each weapon, then earn gold on every challenge.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each Top Fun location. Learn the racing line on the first lap — the drones are fast but the courses are short, so one clean lap usually wins it.
steps: Find each Top Fun Drone Race location.
Win one race at every location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the race types — street, off-road, boat and air all count, and each race only needs to be won once. Variety is the point: do not grind the same race twenty times, it will not count.
steps: Enter races of different types and win each one once.
Track the count in the stats page until it reads 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing duel and out-fish him. The trick is patience: let the fish tire itself out before reeling hard, and never let the line snap.
steps: Find Cal and start a fishing challenge.
Land the bigger catch to beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade and finish one game — any machine, any score. The easiest one is the simplest cabinet; you only need to reach the end, not a high score.
steps: Enter an arcade.
Play any cabinet through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's stranger strand ends with a mission about getting clean — follow his missions to the last one. Stranger strands unlock as the story advances, so check the map for his marker between chapters.
steps: Complete Andy's stranger missions in order.
Finish his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand is boat-heavy — his final mission needs a fast boat and a steady hand at the wheel. Do his missions as they appear and the finale unlocks.
steps: Complete Kenton's stranger missions in order.
Finish his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is all about bikes and the open road. Ride his missions through to the last one — the finale is a long ride, so bring a bike you trust.
steps: Complete Billy's stranger missions in order.
Finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands, start to finish. The strands are Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more the game reveals as you explore — keep an eye on the map for the stranger markers and do each strand the moment it appears.
steps: Find and start each stranger strand on the map.
Complete all 8 strands to their final missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is about moving product around Leonida. His final mission is a delivery under pressure — plan the route before you start the engine.
steps: Complete Randy's stranger missions in order.
Finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends with a spin — literally. Follow his missions through; the finale is more about style than firepower, so enjoy it.
steps: Complete Tyrone's stranger missions in order.
Finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY CONFIRMED MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots (COUNT UNCONFIRMED) — and the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 can only be done from a Chapter 1 save. Keep a manual Chapter 1 save from the start; if you reach the end without it, you must replay the chapter. Do the spots as you find them, and never let the story carry you past Chapter 1 without that save.
steps: Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 — do this first.
Meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot before leaving the chapter.
Meditate at every remaining spot across Leonida (18 spots, COUNT UNCONFIRMED).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a unique animal — a rare beast, not a common one. Track it in the wilds outside the city, use the hunting rifle, and take the shot cleanly. The animal only appears in its own territory, so follow Bret's hints.
steps: Start Bret's strand and follow his hints to the hunting ground.
Track and hunt the unique animal.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full card sets — 3 card sets (COUNT UNCONFIRMED) exist in total, so this is all of them. Cards hide in shops, safehouses and odd corners of the map; buy the ones you can and hunt the rest. A card checklist helps — the tracker marks each set as you finish it.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida (shops, safehouses, hidden spots).
Complete all 3 card sets (COUNT UNCONFIRMED).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK it at 100 locations — 100 WAiNK locations (COUNT UNCONFIRMED) — the longest collectible hunt in the game. The spots are spread across the whole state, so treat it as a road trip: work region by region and let the map fill in as you go. Do not leave it all for the end.
steps: Find WAiNK spots across Leonida, region by region.
WAiNK it at 100 locations (COUNT UNCONFIRMED).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges — the daily and weekly-style tasks the game throws at you, from stunt jumps to photo spots. They stack up naturally if you play broadly; check the challenge list and pick off the easy ones first.
steps: Open the challenge list.
Complete any 50 challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then lose the cops together. The trick is a fast car and a long straight road out of the city — break line of sight, then hide until the stars fade.
steps: Raise a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner present.
Escape and stay hidden until the heat dies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your Wanted Level the whole time — the catch is you must NOT lose the cops between robberies. Pick three shops close together, hit them fast, and keep the heat on until the third till is empty.
steps: Pick three shops close together.
Rob all three back-to-back with your partner, keeping Wanted Level throughout.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive it, and it counts. City traffic covers most of them; the rare ones need the countryside, the airport and the docks. A varied garage fills the list faster than grinding one district.
steps: Drive every vehicle type you find — city, countryside, airport, docks.
Keep going until the list reads 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five enemies, one Combat Focus. Find a mission or a gang hideout with a group clustered together, trigger Combat Focus, and sweep through them before the meter runs out. A shotgun helps.
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — steal a plane and take off without a flight plan. The runway is the hard part: get past security, grab a small plane, and climb before the cops arrive.
steps: Enter VCIA and reach the runway.
Steal a plane and take off.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and survive the heat that follows — the description says it all. Tanks draw a heavy response, so do it somewhere open and keep moving.
steps: Find and enter a Rhino tank.
Survive the response it draws.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected — no alarms, no witnesses, no Wanted Level at all. Go at night, move quietly, take the goods and leave the way you came. If anyone spots you, restart and try a quieter route.
steps: Enter a jewelry store undetected.
Take the goods and leave without raising any alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big jobs — plan the getaway before the robbery, bring a fast car, and never linger after the vault opens.
steps: Plan a getaway car for each bank.
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape every time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, crack it open and get away — the classic. Block the road, deal with the guards fast, grab the cash and vanish before backup arrives.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every corner of Leonida — 52 Leonida areas (COUNT UNCONFIRMED). The map reveals as you travel, so a full road trip through every region fills it in. Check the map for grey patches and drive into them.
steps: Drive through every region of Leonida.
Visit all 52 areas (COUNT UNCONFIRMED) until the map is complete.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — every gang's turf has one. Hit them all; the gangs will not thank you, but the trophy will pop once the last gang's operation is robbed.
steps: Find each gang's illegal operation on the map.
Rob one operation per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: take a seat on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. No combat, no chase — just sit, sip and let the trophy pop. A good first trophy to grab in free roam.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order and enjoy a cocktail with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass, in classic style. Pick a showroom, build speed on the street outside, and crash through the front — the trophy pops as the glass shatters.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive through its front glass at speed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl a full game. You do not need a strike; finishing the game is what counts.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — build your duo's reputation until the crowd notices. Play the partner missions and the co-op activities; the trophy pops when your partnership hits its peak.
steps: Play partner missions and co-op activities.
Raise the partnership's appeal to its peak.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A story-choice trophy: at a key moment the game asks you to choose, and the trophy pops for the choice you make. There is no wrong answer for the trophy itself — but the choice changes the story, so pick the one you can live with.
steps: Reach the story choice the game presents.
Make your choice.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — fail something once, then nail it on the retry. The trophy is the game's joke about persistence: whatever you failed, go back and do it right the second time.
steps: Fail a challenge or mission once.
Retry it and complete it on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange is out there in Leonida — find it and the trophy pops. Follow the odd signals and the stranger rumours; the truth is in a place you would not expect.
steps: Follow the strange signals and rumours.
Find what is out there.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — hit pedestrians with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling-style. A slow drive through a crowded sidewalk does it; the game counts each one.
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon.
Drive past a crowd and strike from the vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts wash them for a cut. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the counter climbs to a quarter million.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food, all of it counts. The big-ticket items (cars and property upgrades) get you there fastest; the small stuff fills the gaps.
steps: Buy big-ticket items first (cars, weapons).
Keep spending across shops until $100,000 is spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages unlock as the story advances and as your cash grows — save up, buy them all, and the trophy pops with the last deed.
steps: Save up and unlock garage properties as they appear.
Purchase every garage property.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — any ten vehicles you own or find. Open the app, register a vehicle, repeat ten times. It is one of the quickest trophies once you have a few cars.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles.
